card.name: Words before exposure or harm conditions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (not, if, when, by, in, like) right where the text is about to say what something must avoid or be exposed to. They sit after a subject that is sensitive, vulnerable or must be protected.

modes.label: Must not be exposed
modes.description: The word 'not' after should or must, just before a statement about avoiding co-use or exposure.
modes.example: whose fetus must<< not>> be exposed to lenalidomide

modes.label: Damaged or harmed by a condition
modes.description: A linking word after a vulnerable item, leading into the agent that harms it.
modes.example: The fibrinogen and thrombin proteins can be denatured<< by>> alcohol, iodine or heavy

modes.label: Conditional hazard wording
modes.description: If or when introducing the circumstance in which harm occurs.
modes.example: which can be harmful,<< if>> applied over too much skin at one time

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with exposure words such as exposed, exposure and expose.
card.plain: It fires on little words that lead into what something should be kept away from or exposed to.
